methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15: BILL (bill.com/product/pricing), Melio (meliopayments.com/pricing), Ramp (ramp.com/pricing), Tipalti (tipalti.com/pricing), Routable (routable.com/pricing), Stampli (stampli.com/pricing), AvidXchange (avidxchange.com). Plooto's official pricing page (plooto.com/pricing) and help-center article are anti-bot 403-blocked; Go/Grow prices confirmed via multiple review sources and the CheckThat.ai mirror, and Pro was CORRECTED from a draft error of $99 to $499/month (corroborated by businessnewsdaily.com and business.com). Quote-only vendors (Stampli, AvidXchange) and quote-only tiers (BILL Enterprise, Ramp Enterprise, Melio Platinum, Tipalti custom, Stampli, Routable Scale/Enterprise) carry monthlyUsd null. Tipalti publishes starting-from prices ($99 AP, $249 Mass Payments). Annual discounts included only where stated. freeTrialDays set null for BILL and Melio (no published trial length; Melio's free plan is a forever tier, not a trial). accessedAt 2026-06-15.
